feature: One Agent pane on the right
summary: The left dock is gone. The right panel's Agent group is the one Agent place: the live request with Stop at its top, and under it a plain history you hover for details.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Press Command K, type a request and press Return.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Watch the Agent group: your words, the live line and Stop are at its top, and nothing opens at the left.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Rest the pointer on the finished row for a moment.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Move the pointer onto the card, then away from it.
Click the row to select what it made.
Press Command Z, then rest on the row again.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Choose Clear History… from the three dots on the Agent header.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Clear, then press Command Z.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: Does the card come up soon enough without popping up while you pass over rows?
Can you get from a row onto the card without it going away?
Is Understood as telling you how your words were read, or only repeating the row?
Are the before and after pictures big enough to see what changed?
Is a yes or no inside the Agent group enough for Clear History, or do you want a dialog?
rough: The Ask mocks were changed to match, as the task asked: agent-generate-wt.html draws the rows and the card (2026-11-04-one-agent-pane-mock.png), agent.html loses the dock button and comp-agent.html says the dock is gone. They match the app.
A request you stop leaves no row, only the Stopped line until the next request. The history holds what changed something.
After Stop during a model load the row goes at once, but a new request waits for the load to end. Task stop-while-ask-s-model-is-still-loading-lets-the covers it.
On a video the pictures show the frame at the playhead, so a change elsewhere in time can look the same in both.
Waiting requests sit above the live one, so the column stays newest first. With nothing waiting the live request is the top line.
Clear History asks in the Agent group rather than a system dialog, so it is not in a window of its own.
The card is glass, so it reads mid grey over a white page. Its small labels use the main text colour to stay legible.
